blockingIssues.description: engine/scripts/cluster-up.sh restores the saved kube context on EXIT, so run-scenario.sh can execute later kubectl/helm steps against the caller's previous cluster instead of the freshly created chart-test-swarm-* cluster.

engine/scripts/run-scenario.sh only tears down failed or interrupted runs when KEEP_CLUSTER=0, leaving chart-test-swarm-* clusters behind on failure/interrupt paths despite the feature contract's cleanup requirement.

engine/scripts/apply-scenario.sh appends --namespace for raw_manifest preinstalls but never creates that namespace first, so namespaced raw-manifest scenarios (VAL-ENGINE-008) fail on a fresh cluster.
engine/testgrid/tests/test_integration_reorg.py freezes primer content with pre-reorg SHA-256 hashes, which turns valid future primer rewrites in later milestones into false failures.

The artifact bundle is not replayable from artifacts/ alone: scenario.yaml keeps source-tree-relative product.chart/fixture references and apply-scenario.sh does not have enough vendored inputs to reproduce the original release from PROJECT_DIR=<artifacts>.

artifacts/applied-overrides.yaml does not contain one final merged helm_values map; it appends separate values-file and product.set fragments, so scenarios that use both sources yield an ambiguous/non-flattened artifact shape.

appliedUpdates.description: Added commands.sweep_scenarios and commands.orphan_audit so future validators can invoke the new F1.5 schema-sweep and orphan-audit scripts via shared state.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Replace `jsonschema -i <scenario.yaml>` guidance with the repo's actual YAML-validation flow (`check-jsonschema` or a documented YAML-to-JSON bridge), require end-to-end `run-scenario.sh` / artifact replay checks for cluster or artifact features, and require `skillFeedback.followedProcedure=false` when live validation is skipped.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: F1.1, F1.2, and F1.4 all missed runtime defects after workers relied on structural checks or skipped required live validation; reviewers also found the shared `jsonschema` guidance stale.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update shared validator guidance to reflect the repo's actual schema-sweep toolchain (`check-jsonschema`, not raw `jsonschema` against YAML) and the now-required `pytest-xdist` dependency for `pytest -n 2`.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: F1.1/F1.5 reviewers found the library still directs validators to `jsonschema`, and scrutiny had to add `pytest-xdist` locally before the declared `commands.test` contract would pass.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify that cluster names come only from the `CLUSTER_NAME` environment variable, not from the scenario schema, and align any references that say the schema rejects unprefixed cluster names.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: F1.1 review found the feature contract and validation docs still mix schema-level cluster-name validation with the documented env-var-only design.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Resolve the contradiction between `KEEP_CLUSTER=1` as the default debug behavior and the mission-wide expectation that failed/interrupted runs leave no chart-test-swarm-* clusters behind.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: F1.1 review found runtime cleanup expectations split across feature text, validation contract, AGENTS.md, and library/environment.md.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Either stop routing cross-cutting shell/YAML harness work through `testgrid-python`, or add instructions to run the shared milestone gate commands when a feature explicitly owns repo-wide test scaffolding.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: F1.5 was assigned the Python-centric skill even though its contract spanned shell, YAML, and repo-wide gates; the original worker only ran plain pytest while claiming the milestone commands passed.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Align the written scenario-YAML convention with the enforced lint policy by either requiring document-start markers in `.yamllint` or removing the `---` requirement from worker guidance.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: F1.5 review found mission AGENTS.md requires `---` on scenario YAMLs while the committed `.yamllint` disables `document-start`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Align Envoy Gateway primer path/name references with the post-reorg location used in the repo so workers and validators are checking the same file.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: F1.2 review found feature/validation text referencing `gateway-api/envoy-gateway.md` while the repo and later mission state use `gateway-api/gateway-api.md`.

rejectedObservations.observation: Add a shared-state note that F1.3's primer hashes are only a one-time reorg check.
